text_shapes:
Executive Statement
The treatment cohort improved conversion across four weeks. The quality guardrail remained inside its agreed range; the sample does not establish long-term retention.

Hypothesis and context
Eligible new-account cohorts · W1–W4 · randomized control and treatment · conversion and quality guardrail.

Interpretation
Treatment conversion rose from 8.2% in week 1 to 9.8% in week 4; the control moved from 8.0% to 8.5%. The treatment distribution is higher across this sample, with all three cohort checks inside the quality guardrail. Continue only as a limited rollout because these four weeks do not establish long-term retention.

Recommendation
Stage a limited treatment rollout
Pause expansion if the quality guardrail moves outside its agreed range.
Review
